invariants: Missing, extra, malformed, stale, future, or unprovenanced stage evidence fails closed; duplicate reason codes and evidence references within a stage are rejected.
Risk must explicitly return APPROVED before a directional decision stage may run.
Execution-instrument mapping is a separate downstream execution gate and must not be conflated with Risk Gate approval for read-only observation.
The orchestrator coordinates existing specialist outputs and must not recompute indicators, market structure, strategy, risk, or outcomes.
The orchestrator does not fetch external data or submit orders.
Evaluation in this stage sequence means decision-observation validation, not realized performance evaluation.
Realized performance belongs to the separate forward outcome/evaluation pipeline and must never be inferred.
The exact canonical market-data source and scope must be supplied by the upstream validated data path.
Unknown contract versions must be rejected, not silently coerced.
Signal, confirmation, market-structure regime, and any directional final decision must agree on direction within the same evidence snapshot; disagreement blocks NO_TRADE at the Mother boundary.
